body: N-11 part A is in PR #29 (not merged, not walked; N-11 is NOT marked built: part B repairs the existing rows). DONE: the library scan (scanner.link_library) looks up, once per page, which song_file row already holds each music-server id (refs.file_holders, the oldest row if several refs hold it) and uses THAT ref: it refreshes the file's own columns and creates nothing; only a file no ref owns is described from its tags as before. migration._ref_for_song uses the same lookup. 12 new tests fail on the old code and pass now; whole server suite 902 passed, 1 xfailed, 11 integration tests deselected (CI runs them). DECISIONS: (1) the PATH is not used: the music server lists a file at a path built from the tags (JAY-Z/[Unknown Album]/Empire State Of Mind.opus) and the keeper saved it at Encore/JAY-Z/Singles/Empire State Of Mind.opus, so no exact comparison exists (177 of 178 pairs differ) and a wrong match would attach the wrong file; (2) no cross-ref check inside attach_file: for the keeper it would either hand ref A's file to ref B (wrong for the youtube-then-youtube pairs, B-110) or turn a keep into fail-and-retry. LEFT, for part B / B-110: (a) repair the 178 doubled pairs (merge, move likes/playlist entries/downloads to the surviving ref) and, AFTER it, add a UNIQUE partial index on song_file.navidrome_song_id (cannot exist while the doubles exist); (b) gap 1: a keeper row with a path and no id (2 of 3,389 rows) can still get a second ref if the scan reaches the file before the keeper's retry attaches the id; it needs the file size stored on the keeper's row (pick_song already uses size) or a lookup on the keeper's side; the xfail(strict) test test_a_file_the_keeper_saved_before_the_music_server_listed_it_is_not_given_a_second_ref is the reminder, remove its marker when closed; (c) gap 2: the 'library then youtube' race (the scan reads the music server's listing before the keeper's attach commits), 0 of 178 on the bench; (d) B-110: the 2 'youtube then youtube' pairs (two refs made by one import, both kept to one file) have a different cause and are not touched.
